_comment: The 40-document FRESH sample of the Part 3 dispatch segmentation (seed 777). Drawn from the dispatch documents of the corpus AFTER the segmenter had been fixed for the classes that the first held-out sample (or27-dispatch-heldout.json) exposed, labelled by hand BEFORE the segmenter was scored on it, and not used to tune anything: its score is the honest estimate for the final segmenter. Same field conventions as the other samples (a null place or addressee is not checked, a null clock means none is printed, a null signer means no person signs it; not_start: a line that must not open the document). Policy as in the 100-document sample: an indorsement printed under the dispatch it is on stays with it, an indorsement with a dateline of its own is a dispatch, a forwarded message with no signature of its own stays in the message that forwards it. after_id is the id the corpus gave the document at drawing time.
